name: Total Solar Eclipse 2027 — August 2
job: Plan a safe and evidence-aware eclipse viewing trip without mistaking regional visibility for local totality or using unverified contact times.
facets: Totality versus partial visibility by geographic region
Local viewing plan with user-verified contact times
Solar eye protection and optical equipment safeguards
source_notes: NASA confirms 2 August 2027 total eclipse and broad geographic visibility. NASA GSFC path tables quantify central-line circumstances but are not location-specific guarantees; lunar limb corrections can move limits. No ticket, hotel, visa, local weather or exact contact time is inferred.
